roots.origin: 拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常、成例），来自 consuescere（习惯于）；经古法语 costume 入英语。旧时按成例缴纳的税费即 customs（关税），常来照顾生意的人即 customer
roots.core_concept: the way long repeated until it counts as the way / 做惯了，于是成了该那么做
roots.core_image: 同一条路走了几十年，草都被踩出一道浅沟

roots.origin: 拉丁语 favere（善待、偏袒、喝彩），名词 favor（好意、青睐）；经古法语 favour 入英语
roots.core_concept: to lean toward one side and wish it well / 心偏向某一边，盼它好
roots.core_image: 看台上手掌全朝着一边拍，另一边冷冷清清
roots.english_definition: to be kind to, to favour

roots.origin: 拉丁语 pingere（用颜色涂画、绣饰），过去分词 pictus；经古法语 peindre 入英语成 paint，picture、pigment 同出此支
roots.core_concept: to lay colour onto a surface / 把颜色敷到面上去
roots.core_image: 刷子蘸上颜色，在板面上抹开，木纹一点点被盖住

roots.origin: 拉丁语 experiri（试一试、亲身尝过），由 ex（出来）＋ peritus（试过的、有经验的）一支构成；periculum（危险，本义「试出来的凶险」）同根
roots.core_concept: knowledge got by trying it oneself / 亲手试过才落下来的那点东西
roots.core_image: 手伸进水里试了一下，凉热心里就有了数

roots.origin: 拉丁语 planus（平的、无起伏的）；plan 本指画在平面上的图样，explanare（ex＋planus）是「把褶皱摊平」故引申为讲清楚，plain 亦同源
roots.core_concept: flat with nothing standing in the way / 摊得平平的，没有起伏遮挡
roots.core_image: 一张纸铺开压平，褶子都推到边上去了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 planta（幼苗、插枝），动词 plantare（栽种）本义是「用脚掌把苗踩进土里」（planta 亦指脚掌）；与 planus（平）不同词，勿混
roots.core_concept: a shoot pressed down into soil to grow / 把幼苗按进土里让它长
roots.core_image: 苗根塞进坑里，脚掌把周围的土踩实
roots.english_definition: shoot, sprout, to set in soil

roots.origin: 希腊语 polis（城邦），politēs（城邦公民）、politikos（关于城邦公共事务的）由此出；英语 police、policy 同出此支
roots.core_concept: the affairs of the city held in common / 城邦里众人共管的那些事
roots.core_image: 广场上一群人围着争执，事关全城谁都要开口

concepts.concept: the way long repeated until it counts as the way
concepts.core_image: 同一条路走了几十年，草被踩出一道浅沟

concepts.concept: to lean toward one side and wish it well
concepts.core_image: 看台上手掌全朝一边拍，另一边冷清

concepts.concept: to lay colour onto a surface
concepts.core_image: 刷子蘸色在板面抹开，木纹一点点被盖住

concepts.core_image: 手伸进水里试一下，凉热心里就有了数

concepts.concept: a shoot pressed down into soil to grow
concepts.core_image: 苗根塞进坑里，脚掌把周围的土踩实

concepts.concept: the affairs of the city held in common
concepts.core_image: 广场上众人围着争执，事关全城谁都要开口

words.root_logic: consuetudo（惯常）→ 一地长年照做的成例；按成例缴的税即关税一义
words.origin: 古法语 costume，来自拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常）← consuescere（习惯于）
words.native_definition: a way of behaving long established in a place; duties paid on imports
words.core_concept: what a place has done so long that it now counts as proper – 一地做久了、如今被认作该那么做的事
words.core_image: 每年这天各家都摆一样的供品，谁也说不清是从哪辈起的
examples: It is a local custom to bring flowers.
The goods were held at customs.
semantic_expansions: 习俗/惯例：一地长年照做、被认作该如此的事
关税：旧时按成例向过境货物征收的那笔
words.recall_hint: consuetudo（惯常）→ 做久成例；按例缴的税即关税

words.root_logic: custom（成例）+ -ary（…的）→ 照成例来的、素来如此的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consuetudinarius（依惯例的），来自 consuetudo
words.native_definition: according to what is usually done
words.core_concept: following the groove already worn in – 顺着早被踩出来的那道沟走
words.core_image: 他照素来的做法先斟茶再落座，一步没差
examples: It is customary to tip the driver.
He took his customary seat by the window.
semantic_expansions: 习惯上的/惯常的：顺着早已踩出的那道沟来
words.recall_hint: custom（成例）+ -ary → 顺着旧沟、素来如此

words.root_logic: custom（惯常照顾）+ -er（人）→ 惯常上门买东西的那个人
words.origin: 英语 customer，来自 custom（惯常光顾）← 拉丁语 consuetudo
words.native_definition: a person who buys goods or services from a shop or business
words.core_concept: the one who keeps coming back to the same counter – 一趟趟回到同一个柜台的那个人
words.core_image: 掌柜一抬头就知道他要哪一样，来的回数太多了
examples: The shop has many regular customers.
A customer complained about the delay.
semantic_expansions: 顾客/客户：惯常回到同一处买东西的人
words.recall_hint: custom（惯常光顾）+ -er → 一趟趟回来的那个人

words.root_logic: favere（善待、偏袒）→ 给某一边的好意；也指为人做的那件方便事
words.origin: 古法语 favour，来自拉丁语 favor（好意、青睐）← favere
words.native_definition: kind approval or support; a kind act done for someone
words.core_concept: the good will turned toward one side – 朝某一边送去的那份好意
words.core_image: 他把手一挥，众人的掌声全往那一边去了
examples: Could you do me a favor?
The plan found favor with the board.
semantic_expansions: 恩惠：为人做的那件方便事
赞成/偏爱：心朝某一边送去的好意
words.recall_hint: favere（善待偏袒）→ 朝某一边送去的好意

words.root_logic: favor（好意）+ -able（可…的）→ 带着好意的、于我有利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 favorabilis（讨喜的、有利的），来自 favor ← favere
words.native_definition: showing approval; helpful and likely to bring advantage
words.core_concept: with the wind leaning one's own way – 风向偏在自己这一边
words.core_image: 风顺着帆往前推，船比预定快了半日
examples: The weather was favorable for sailing.
She gave a favorable reply.
semantic_expansions: 赞同的：带着好意的
有利的/顺利的：势头偏在自己这一边
words.recall_hint: favor（好意）+ -able → 好意所向、势头偏向自己

words.root_logic: favor（偏爱）+ -ite（受…的）→ 得那份偏爱最多的
words.origin: 意大利语 favorito（受宠者），来自 favorire ← 拉丁语 favere
words.native_definition: liked more than all others of the same kind
words.core_concept: the one the leaning always settles on – 那份偏心总落在它头上
words.core_image: 一柜子的杯子，他伸手拿的永远是同一只
examples: This is my favorite song.
Blue is her favorite color.
semantic_expansions: 最喜欢的/最爱的：偏心总落在它头上的那一个
words.recall_hint: favor（偏爱）+ -ite → 偏心总落在它头上

words.root_logic: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那种颜色；也指作画这件事
words.origin: 古法语 peint（涂过的），peindre 的过去分词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: coloured liquid put on a surface; to make a picture with colour
words.core_concept: the colour laid on, and the laying of it – 敷上去的那层色，以及敷色这件事
words.core_image: 刷子在板上来回一趟，后头的木纹就看不见了
examples: The door needs a fresh coat of paint.
She paints in oils.
semantic_expansions: 油漆/颜料：敷到面上的那层色
绘画：把色敷成图这件事
words.recall_hint: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那层色及敷色之事

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -er（人）→ 干敷色这活的人：作画的或刷漆的
words.origin: 英语 painter，来自 paint ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a person who paints pictures, or who paints buildings as a job
words.core_concept: the one whose work is laying colour on – 以敷色为活计的那个人
words.core_image: 他蹲在梯子下调色，桶边一圈干了的痕
examples: The painter finished the portrait.
We hired a painter for the kitchen.
semantic_expansions: 画家：以敷色作画为业的人
油漆工：以敷色刷面为业的人
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -er → 干敷色这活的人

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物，及敷色这门事
words.origin: 英语 painting，来自 paint 的动名词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a picture made with paint; the art or act of painting
words.core_concept: what the laid colour has become – 那层色最后成了的样子
words.core_image: 框子里那一幅挂上墙，颜色厚得能看出笔痕
examples: The painting hangs in the hall.
She studied painting in Paris.
semantic_expansions: 画作：敷色所成的那一幅
绘画：敷色成图这门事本身
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物与其事

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ence → 亲身试过后留下来的那点本事
words.origin: 拉丁语 experientia（试验所得），来自 experiri（亲身试过）
words.native_definition: knowledge or skill gained by doing something; an event one lives through
words.core_concept: what stays with one after having tried it – 试过之后留在身上的那点东西
words.core_image: 手在水里试过几回，伸进去就知道够不够烫
examples: She has years of teaching experience.
It was a frightening experience.
semantic_expansions: 经验：亲身试过后留下的本事
体验/经历：亲身走过的那一遭
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）→ 试过后留在身上的东西

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ment → 特意安排的一次试，看会出什么
words.origin: 拉丁语 experimentum（试验、检验），来自 experiri
words.native_definition: a scientific test done to find out what happens
words.core_concept: a trying set up on purpose to see what comes out – 特意摆开来试一次，看结果怎样
words.core_image: 两只杯子只差一样条件，摆在一处等着看分别
examples: They ran the experiment three times.
The experiment confirmed her theory.
semantic_expansions: 实验/试验：特意安排的一次试，用来看结果
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ment → 特意摆开试一次

words.root_logic: experiment（试一次）+ -al（…的）→ 尚在试的、拿来试的
words.origin: 英语 experimental，来自 experiment ← 拉丁语 experiri
words.native_definition: based on new methods not yet proved; used for testing
words.core_concept: still at the trying stage, not yet settled – 还在试的阶段，尚未定下来
words.core_image: 那台机器还摆在台上，参数天天改
examples: The treatment is still experimental.
They set up an experimental farm.
semantic_expansions: 实验的/试验性的：还在试、尚未定下来的
words.recall_hint: experiment（试一次）+ -al → 还在试的阶段

words.root_logic: planus（平面）→ 画在平面上的图样 → 打算、方案；动词即谋划
words.origin: 法语 plan（平面图），来自拉丁语 planus（平的）
words.native_definition: a detailed proposal for doing something; a drawing seen from above
words.core_concept: the layout drawn flat before anything is built – 动工之前先摊在平面上画出来的那套
words.core_image: 桌上铺开一张图，每一处都先在纸上定好位置
examples: We made a plan for the weekend.
The architect showed us the floor plan.
semantic_expansions: 计划/方案：动工前先在平面上定下的那套
平面图：从上方看、摊平画出的那张图
words.recall_hint: planus（平面）→ 先摊平画出来的那套

words.root_logic: planus（平的）→ 平面；机翼是平展的面，故 aeroplane 截短为 plane；刨子是找平的工具
words.origin: 拉丁语 planus（平的）；飞机义来自 aeroplane（aer 空气＋planus 平面）的截短
words.native_definition: a flat surface; an aircraft; a tool for smoothing wood
words.core_concept: a face with no rise in it, and things named for such a face – 没有起伏的那个面，以及以此得名之物
words.core_image: 推子沿着木头走过去，凸起的一层卷成花掉在地上
examples: Draw two lines on the same plane.
Our plane landed on time.
semantic_expansions: 平面：没有起伏的那个面
飞机：因平展机翼得名（aeroplane 截短）
刨子：把面找平的那件工具
words.recall_hint: planus（平的）→ 无起伏的面，及因此得名之物

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）+ -ation → 把褶子摊平摊开 → 讲清楚的那番话
words.origin: 拉丁语 explanatio（阐明），来自 explanare（摊平、讲清）← ex＋planus
words.native_definition: a statement that makes something clear or gives a reason
words.core_concept: smoothing the folds out until the whole thing lies plain – 把褶皱一一摊开，整件事平平摆着
words.core_image: 他把揉皱的那张纸一点点抹平，字才认得出来
examples: He gave no explanation for the delay.
Her explanation satisfied everyone.
semantic_expansions: 解释/说明：把褶皱摊平、让人看清那番话
解释的理由：摊平之后露出来的原委
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）→ 把褶子摊开讲清

words.root_logic: planta（幼苗）→ 长在土里的活物；动词是把苗按进土里。厂房义由「设置安放」引申
words.origin: 古英语 plante 借自拉丁语 planta（幼苗），动词 plantare（栽种）
words.native_definition: a living thing that grows in soil; a factory; to put in the ground to grow
words.core_concept: the shoot set into soil, and by extension anything set in place to work – 按进土里的那株苗，引申为安置到位以运作之物
words.core_image: 苗根塞进坑里，土一踩实，叶子第二天就抬起来了
examples: Water the plants every morning.
They plant rice in early summer.
semantic_expansions: 植物：按进土里长起来的活物
种植：把苗按进土里这件事
工厂：由「安置到位以运作」引申而来的厂房
words.recall_hint: planta（幼苗）→ 按进土里的苗；引申为安置到位之物

words.root_logic: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽种的那块地
words.origin: 拉丁语 plantatio（栽种），来自 plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: a large area where crops such as tea or rubber are grown
words.core_concept: ground where the setting-in was done row upon row – 一垄接一垄都按进苗去的那片地
words.core_image: 一垄接一垄望不到头，每株间距都一样
examples: He works on a tea plantation.
The plantation covers two hundred acres.
semantic_expansions: 种植园/人造林：成片按苗栽下的那块地
words.recall_hint: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽下苗的那块地

words.root_logic: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来栽到别处 → 移栽；医学上指移植器官
words.origin: 拉丁语 transplantare（移栽），来自 trans＋plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: to move a plant to another place; to move an organ into another body
words.core_concept: lifting what was set in one spot and setting it into another – 把按在这处的起出来，按到那处去
words.core_image: 带着根土整株起出来，挪到新坑里再踩实
examples: We transplanted the seedlings today.
He received a heart transplant.
semantic_expansions: 移栽：把苗起出来栽到别处
移植：同一动作用在器官上
words.recall_hint: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来按到别处

words.root_logic: polit（城邦公事）+ -ics（…之学/之事）→ 争夺与处置公共事务这一摊
words.origin: 希腊语 politika（城邦事务），来自 politikos ← polis（城邦）
words.native_definition: the activities of government and of gaining power in it
words.core_concept: the wrangling over what the whole city should do – 围着「全城该怎么办」争出来的那一摊事
words.core_image: 广场中央吵成一片，各方都想让自己那套算数
examples: He went into politics at thirty.
Office politics wore her down.
semantic_expansions: 政治/政治学：处置公共事务这一摊及其学问
权术：为在其中占上风而使的手段
words.recall_hint: polit（城邦公事）+ -ics → 争夺处置公事这一摊

words.root_logic: polit（城邦公事）+ -ical（…的）→ 与公共事务、权力相关的
words.origin: 希腊语 politikos（关于城邦的），来自 polis
words.native_definition: relating to government or public affairs
words.core_concept: belonging to what the whole city argues over – 属于全城要争议的那类事
words.core_image: 这件事一摆上广场，各方立刻按立场分了边
examples: It became a political issue overnight.
She has strong political views.
semantic_expansions: 政治的/政党的：属于城邦公共事务与权力的
words.recall_hint: polit（城邦公事）+ -ical → 属于公共事务的

words.root_logic: politic（城邦公事）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以处置公共事务为业的人
words.origin: 英语 politician，来自 politic ← 希腊语 polis
words.native_definition: a person whose job is in government or seeking elected office
words.core_concept: the one who stands in the square and speaks for a side – 站到广场上替一方开口的那个人
words.core_image: 他登上台阶开口，底下的人分头喝彩与嘘声
examples: The politician avoided the question.
She is a career politician.
semantic_expansions: 政治家/政客：以处置公共事务为业、替一方发声的人
words.recall_hint: politic（城邦公事）+ -ian → 以处置公事为业的人
